policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: The #369 body-observer ownership fix adds one instrumented and covered client/core line so stale handles compare their exact subscriber identity before cleanup, advancing the reviewed high-water from 2326/2666 (87.247%) to 2327/2667 (87.252%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 1788 tests across 233 files and reproduced exactly 2327/2667. Retaining the existing one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2326/2667 (87.214%), stricter than the prior 2325/2666 tolerated floor (87.209%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The final #453 host-semantics review pass lets Static Files decide Range/If-Range before passing through genuine 206/416 responses or injecting ignored full responses, parses conditional entity tags with the installed typed parser, combines source preconditions with Static Files' native state ordering, ignores future dates, and normalizes fallback 304/412 metadata. Real Static Files plus malformed, future-date, weak-tag, and conflicting-precondition regressions advance the reviewed high-water by 52 covered lines while adding 38 instrumented lines. Six clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 2,310 tests at the same 36,205-line scope: the first measured the reviewed high-water at 27,486 covered lines (75.918%), one repeat measured 27,485, and four repeats measured 27,484. Retaining the existing evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 27,481/36,205 (75.904%), stricter than the prior 27,429/36,167 tolerated floor (75.840%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
